NineSwordTechniques:ParalysisHarvest.NAME: Paralysis Harvest
NineSwordTechniques:ParalysisHarvest.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL If the target has at least 5 nineswordtechniques:paralysis, gain 2 nineswordtechniques:vitality and draw 1 card. NL (Current Vitality !NSTV!)
NineSwordTechniques:ParalysisHarvest.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL If the target has at least 4 nineswordtechniques:paralysis, gain 3 nineswordtechniques:vitality and draw 1 card. NL (Current Vitality !NSTV!)

NineSwordTechniques:AbsoluteParalysis.NAME: Absolute Paralysis
NineSwordTechniques:AbsoluteParalysis.DESCRIPTION: Enemy nineswordtechniques:paralysis loses only half its stacks (rounded up) at the end of their turn.
NineSwordTechniques:AbsoluteParalysis.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Enemy nineswordtechniques:paralysis loses only half its stacks (rounded up) at the end of their turn.

NineSwordTechniques:NerveRupture.NAME: Nerve Rupture
NineSwordTechniques:NerveRupture.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage and remove all nineswordtechniques:paralysis from the target. Deal 2 additional damage per stack removed.
NineSwordTechniques:NerveRupture.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage and remove all nineswordtechniques:paralysis from the target. Deal 3 additional damage per stack removed.

NineSwordTechniques:DualityConvergence.NAME: Duality Convergence
NineSwordTechniques:DualityConvergence.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you change nineswordtechniques:persona, gain 2 nineswordtechniques:vitality and apply 2 nineswordtechniques:paralysis to ALL enemies. NL (Current Vitality !NSTV!)
NineSwordTechniques:DualityConvergence.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Whenever you change nineswordtechniques:persona, gain 3 nineswordtechniques:vitality and apply 3 nineswordtechniques:paralysis to ALL enemies. NL (Current Vitality !NSTV!)

NineSwordTechniques:VitalityRiot.NAME: Vitality Riot
NineSwordTechniques:VitalityRiot.DESCRIPTION: Spend all nineswordtechniques:vitality. NL Deal damage to ALL enemies equal to !M! times the amount spent. NL Exhaust. NL (Current Vitality !NSTV!)
NineSwordTechniques:VitalityRiot.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Spend all nineswordtechniques:vitality. NL Deal damage to ALL enemies equal to !M! times the amount spent. NL Exhaust. NL (Current Vitality !NSTV!)

NineSwordTechniques:LifeSource.NAME: Life Source
NineSwordTechniques:LifeSource.DESCRIPTION: Heal 1 HP for every !M! HP you have lost.
NineSwordTechniques:LifeSource.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Heal 1 HP for every !M! HP you have lost.

NineSwordTechniques:SeeThroughIllusion.NAME: See Through Illusion
NineSwordTechniques:SeeThroughIllusion.DESCRIPTION: If you are in Leixier's nineswordtechniques:persona, apply 1 Vulnerable to the target and gain !M! Strength.
NineSwordTechniques:SeeThroughIllusion.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: If you are in Leixier's nineswordtechniques:persona, apply 1 Vulnerable to the target and gain !M! Strength.

NineSwordTechniques:CombatInstinct.NAME: Combat Instinct
NineSwordTechniques:CombatInstinct.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to a random enemy 2 times.
NineSwordTechniques:CombatInstinct.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to a random enemy 2 times.
